overview: Ferrari's first series-production mid-engine PHEV supercar (introduced 2019). 4.0L twin-turbo V8 (769 hp) paired with three electric motors (two front axle, one between engine and 8-speed DCT) for 986 hp combined with AWD via electric front axle. MY2025 is final production year for the base SF90 Stradale per Ferrari's 2026 announcement; the XX variants continue and a successor is in development. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferrari_SF90_Stradale, https://www.ferrari.com/en-EN/auto/sf90-stradale
